item.title: Worldview Weekly — October 22, 2026
item.description: Welcome to Worldview Weekly, an analytical complement to The Economist. This week, we look beneath the headline measure. A total can be accurate and still conceal the question that matters: who participates, who carries risk, which capabilities endure, and what gets lost. We begin with economics and political institutions, then move to science, culture, and development. For each reading, we distinguish the author’s argument from our own analysis. The examples introduced as hypothetical are illustrations, not reported events. Publisher links and the reading list are in the written feed.
